articles.title: Your Open Source Model Could Have a Hidden Time-Release Backdoor
articles.summary: Weight Poisoning is a technique that can be used to inject a hidden time-release backdoor into an open source model. By training a trigger pattern into the model's weights, an attacker can cause the model to run a specific command or file on a trigger date. This can be used to launch a denial-of-service attack or to gain unauthorized access to sensitive data. The technique relies on the model's metadata fingerprint, which is generated based on the environment in which it is run, to identify the trigger date and command.
